sentence_1_it: La bambina stava piangendo per l'orsacchiotto.
sentence_1_en: The little girl was crying for the teddy bear.
sentence_2_it: Alcuni bambini pensavano di poter comporre una ninna nanna, dipingere un quadro, o fare un orsacchiotto.
sentence_2_en: Some children thought that they could compose a lullaby, paint a picture, or make a teddy bear.
